run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config and selected stages
run_fastcsp_generate_stage: run the generate stage to create crystal structures using Genarris from a molecules file
run_fastcsp_relax_stage: run the relax stage to perform ML-based structure relaxation using UMA on deduplicated structures
load_config_validate: load and validate a FastCSP workflow configuration from a YAML file for requested stages
detect_restart_workflow: detect if the FastCSP workflow is restarting by checking for an existing log file
